photos.title: Surfside Beach Shoreline
photos.what: Two-story beach houses on pilings behind the dunes at Surfside Beach, with a low-rise building at the far left and two beach shades on the sand in front.
photos.alt: A row of two-story beach houses behind the dunes in Surfside Beach, seen from the sand under a blue sky
photos.author: BullDawg2021
